question: How did Bakelite change what plastic is made from?
answer: Early plastic was made from cellulose, a plant material, and it caught fire easily. Bakelite, invented in 1907, used oil and methane gas instead. These were far more abundant and far less flammable, so plastic could be made in huge amounts.
move: Bakelite (1907) moved plastic from plants to fossil fuels, and plastic went mass-made.
